headline: Rollout gets half of the pilot's results
subline: Pilot with targeted communication vs rollout today, % of clients
annotation: The pilot playbook is the cheapest Go Big lever; P3 finds what made the difference.
source: Source: case study brief; rollout enrolment = silent start (13%), reward choice = rollout today (34.3%).
notes: Same programme, two very different results. With targeted communication in the Hradec Králové pilot, 24.6 percent of clients enrolled; with the silent start only 13. In the pilot 63 percent chose a reward; in the rollout today 34.
On both measures the rollout gets about half of what the pilot did. That is not a product problem, it is execution: communication, timing, how the reward is presented.
So the cheapest lever for Go Big is to understand exactly what made the pilot work and copy it. That is priority 3. One caveat I will check: whether pilot clients were selected differently.
